verdict.rationale: Gemini in BigQuery is a documented built-in assistant. It generates and suggests SQL/Python and explains queries. It can find, join, query and visualize tables from natural-language requests. Conversational analytics supports configurable data agents, and data canvas and data insights add automated exploration and analysis. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegating tasks to the assistant works well in practice, and explicit documentation of autonomous multi-step task execution beyond guided NL-to-query/visualization flows.
